st.t: Talk to Kaqemeex in the Druids' Circle in Taverley.
s: I'm in search of a quest.

st.t: Talk to Sanfew upstairs in the Taverley herblore store.
s: I've been sent to help purify the Varrock stone circle.

st.t: Enter Taverley Dungeon south of Taverley.

In Taverley Dungeon, head north past the skeletons to the Prison door on the east side, with a suit of armour on each side. Keep tapping the door until it opens to enter the room with the cauldron. This lets you skip the fight with the suits of armour.
Use the four meats on the cauldron in Taverley dungeon.
Bring the enchanted meats to Sanfew upstairs in the Taverley herblore store.
Return to Kaqemeex in the Druids' Circle to finish the quest.
